# Schema builder (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`schema-builder`](../../flows/schema-builder/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The owner builds a content type definition as a field tree and exports it as JSON (flow schema-builder). The page (`/schema-builder`, owner only) starts or imports a definition, edits the type keys, shows the cms-api check live and exports the JSON. The canvas lists the fields (component boxes hold their own lists); every add, move, duplicate and delete has a plain control, the selected field opens in the property panel, and rows with validator errors carry a marker.

## Techniques

One pure reducer owns the tree: ids are client-only, depth (3 levels) and the per-type key set (SB-8) are kept here; every other rule is left to the cms-api validator (D24). Refused actions return the same state object.

## Technologies

lucide-react (palette icons); the check runs through `useDefinitionValidation` of the content-types feature; copy in the `schemaBuilder` screen.

## Entry points

`SchemaBuilderPage` (route `SCHEMA_BUILDER`), `SchemaCanvas`, `SchemaDragContext`, `PropertyPanel`, `FieldPalette`, `useSchemaBuilderNavItems`, `schemaTreeReducer`, `addField`, `moveTargetsOf`, `FIELD_TYPES`.

## Where to change what

A new field type: one entry in `FIELD_TYPES` plus one copy label. A new tree action: one case in `SchemaTree.reducer.ts`. A new row control: `FieldRow.tsx` plus the handler in `SchemaCanvas.tsx`. Drag rules (offered lists, drop place, announcements): `SchemaDragContext.tsx` with its copy under `dnd`. A new field key control: `PropertyPanel.tsx`. Export rules (when it is enabled, what it shows): `ExportPanel.tsx`. A new import refusal: `SchemaJson.rules.ts` plus its copy line under `import.refusal`. The task file list named `views-schema-builder.md`; this existing doc of the same folder was filled instead.
